newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Becker says film, TV strong in half.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Becker says film, TV strong in half.

text.p: Film production and distribution group Becker Group Ltd said on Monday an increase in its first half net profit was due to strong performances from both its film and television activities.
Becker reported a half year net profit of A$2.23 million in the six months ended December 31, compared with A$1.92 million a year earlier.

"The group expects to continue its success in Australia and Asia with increased television production particularly in the area of light entertainment such game shows," managing director Richard Becker said in a statement.

Becker said the group has formed an agreement with Polygram Filmed Entertainment, a unit of PolyGram NV, to handle the distribution of its feature films to video for both the rental and sell-through market.
Becker shares closed six cents up at A$1.34.
